dataList.content:
There are apparently more terrorists this time, on a fiercer offense than before.
据说恐怖分子的数量有所增加，攻势似乎比之前更猛烈。

So the commotion earlier was a distraction to keep us here.
之前的骚动是故意把我们留在这里的诱饵吗。

Kgh... This could have easily been prevented if it weren't for your collusion.
切……要不是你们有人跟他们串通一气，这是完全可以避免的。

Outis lashed out in frustration.
奥提斯发起了脾气。

It does feel rather strange... I think this is the first time we're going through a Lobotomy Corp. branch without facing a single Abnormality.
感觉有点奇怪……明明来到脑叶公司支部，却连一个异想体都没有遇到，这还是头一次。

That's true indeed. Those we did see were resting still in their eggs.
是啊。异想体们都维持着卵的形态，还真是不可思议。

The bounders from tech liberation whatever must have got some way to put Abnormalities in their eggs without lifting a hand, eh?
那些叫技术解放……什么的家伙们看来是有什么能够不费吹灰之力就把些异想体变回卵的能力啊？

Though we will have to see the details with our own eyes... If they really do have the technology to revert Abnormalities into their inactive forms...
具体情况要亲眼看过才知道……不过，如果那些人真的拥有能够将异想体变回卵的技术……

It's certain that they possess the technologies to achieve more.
很显然，他们可能还有在那之上的更多技术。

Well well, sounds like you've gotta look out, Dongrang, bud... Ms. Faust isn't one to say ominous stuff for nothing, you know.
嗯嗯，这下可得小心了，东朗先生……浮士德小姐可不是会随便说出这么不吉利的话的人。
